A '''battle''' occurred between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] naval forces over [[Sarapin Four]]. The battle resulted in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class Cruiser]] ''[[Enkindle]]'' being disabled.<ref name="TOR" />

==Background==
The ''Enkindle'' had been a part of a failed incursion into Imperial space and upon refusing to turn back, it was damaged by the Imperial [[dreadnought]] [[Tears of Taris|''Tears of Tari''s]]. Fleeing back to Republic space, the warship attempted to hide in the upper atmosphere of [[Sarapin Four]] whilst awaiting reinforcements. The ''Enkindle'' was however discovered and an [[Standard hour|hour]] later the Empire had scrambled all available forces. This included the elite [[Empire's Fury]] squadron.<ref name="TOR" />

==The battle==
Three [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]] flew into the atmosphere of Sarapin Four along side the Empire's Fury and attacked the ''Enkindle'' and its escorts. The three [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]] were already present and each attempted to intercept the Imperial fleet but suffered heavy damage in the process. The Empire's Fury squadron continues towards the ''Enkindle'', fending off [[Liberator-class starfighter|''Liberator''-class starfighters]] and two further escorts while nearing the warship. As the battle commenced two additional ''Thranta''-class Corvettes entered the system to aid the ''Enkindle'' and its escorts but could not change the battles outcome. During its attack runs, the Imperial attack squadron had disabled shields, weapons and the bridge of the Enkindle, crippling the warship and enabling its capture.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle appears as the space combat mission "Sarapin Assault", available to Imperial players in the MMORPG [[Star Wars: The Old Republic]] and is part of [[Operation Eternal Domain]] together with [[Battle of Nez Peron|Nez Peron Sweep]].<ref name="TOR" />
